quotes.text: It fundamentally synergizes artificial intelligence (multimodal LSTM, PSO), the Internet of Things, knowledge graphs, and digital twins. The proposed approach is rigorously evaluated through a hybrid simulation framework encompassing system dynamics and discrete event modeling.
